convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load the external BlauErgodicMDI custom indicator, and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Multi-mode entry logic with three algorithm variants adds complexity.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts trading
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal timestamp calculation for UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime

other_exits: In 'breakdown' mode: long closes when histogram goes negative, short closes when histogram goes positive
In 'twist' mode: long closes when histogram starts declining, short closes when histogram starts rising
In 'cloudtwist' mode: long closes when UpCloud drops below DnCloud, short closes when UpCloud rises above DnCloud
Exit permissions are controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MM is negative, it is treated as a fixed lot size. When MM is positive, it is treated as a share/fraction of the deposit, with the calculation method determined by MMMode (LOT, FO, MM, or LMM as defined in TradeAlgorithms.mqh)

custom_logic_notes: Three mutually exclusive algorithm modes selected via 'Mode' enum: (1) 'breakdown' - histogram crosses zero line using buffer index 2; (2) 'twist' - histogram direction change (3 bars compared) using buffer index 2; (3) 'cloudtwist' - signal cloud crossover using buffer indices 0 (Up) and 1 (Dn). Entry signals use previous bars (SignalBar offset, default=1), comparing bar[SignalBar] vs bar[SignalBar+1] (and bar[SignalBar+2] for twist). Each mode generates both open and close signals simultaneously. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are set to the next bar open time and passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. A Recount flag triggers signal recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans gate whether each signal type is acted upon.
python_conversion_notes: The BlauErgodicMDI custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python using the CXMA class methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (supports JJMA, VIDIA, AMA, and standard MA methods). The indicator has 3 buffers: buffer 0 (Up cloud line), buffer 1 (Down cloud line), buffer 2 (Histogram). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must also be reimplemented. Position sizing uses conditional logic: negative MM = fixed lots, positive MM = deposit fraction based on MMMode enum. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are large suggesting this is designed for 5-digit pricing (100.0 / 200.0 pips equivalent). The SignalBar=1 default means signals are evaluated on the last closed bar, not the forming bar, which is good for backtesting accuracy.
